Consultancy.title: Business consultancy for shop owners
Consultancy.subtitle: Whether you are opening your first shop or growing an established one, we help you advertise, get online and run a better business.
Consultancy.servicesSubtitle: Four services, built for local businesses in Bangladesh.
Consultancy.newBusinessDesc: You have an idea or a shop about to open. We help with naming, branding, your first ads and a simple website so you launch looking established.
Consultancy.existingShopDesc: You already have customers. We help you advertise to more of your area, generate fresh creatives every week and understand what is actually working.
Consultancy.step1Desc: Category, area, what you sell and what you want more of — takes about two minutes.
Consultancy.step2Desc: An advisor reviews your shop and recommends the services that fit your budget.
Consultancy.step3Desc: Ads go live, your site goes online, and you track results from your dashboard.
Consultancy.adCreationDesc: Professionally designed ads for your shop — printed posters, Facebook and Instagram creatives, and offer banners shown across Discounty.
Consultancy.aiAdDesc: Describe your offer in Bengali or English and get ready-to-post ad images and captions in seconds. Regenerate as often as you like.
Consultancy.websiteDesc: A fast, mobile-first website for your shop with your products, offers, location and a direct WhatsApp ordering button.
Consultancy.guideDesc: Practical, step-by-step guidance on trade licences, pricing, stock management, bookkeeping and hiring — written for Bangladeshi shop owners.
Consultancy.ctaDesc: Tell us what you need and an advisor will get back to you within one working day.
Consultancy.formMessage: Tell us briefly what you want to achieve
